final_text: {"declined":{"reason":"Cannot author MOD-GEO geography correspondence: survey subnational id columns (mouza/union/etc.) have no value labels and the available tools do not expose the full set of observed codes, but correspondence.links must enumerate every code.","needs":["A tool/view that lists all distinct observed values for numeric/categorical columns without value labels (e.g., distinct values for rt001.mouza/union/region/district/thana), or access to those columns' value lists / frequency tables","Alternatively, confirmation of an existing survey column that already contains the representative geography as a labeled categorical/string domain suitable for correspondence linking"]}}
